description: FUNCTION SMALLEST-ALGEBRAIC (ISO 15.83) - the smallest positive value that may increment argument-1, from its PICTURE/usage description alone (NOT its runtime contents). LIVE (P11: the fold pre-existed via BindAlgebraicFold; Step 7 added the golden + window row): a compile-time PICTURE fold = 10^(-scale) - S999 -> +1, 99V9(3) -> 0.001, S9PP -> +100, BINARY-CHAR -> +1 (the 15.83.4 RVR2 NOTE table). argument-1 shall be a category-numeric DATA ITEM (15.83.3 AR1 - stricter than HIGHEST/LOWEST-ALGEBRAIC: NO numeric-edited, no literal/expression/function). NEW-IN-2023 (Annex E.3 item 29 'has been added'); at --std 2014 or below the D8 catalog window rejects by name+edition (COBOL1502).
citation: ISO §2023:15.83 SMALLEST-ALGEBRAIC; AR1 numeric DATA ITEM only (no numeric-edited); NEW-IN-2023 (Annex E.3 item 29)
vcr: M2/M3 catalog SMALLEST-ALGEBRAIC; 2023 introduction (Annex E.3 item 29 'has been added'; Annex E.2 item 13 lists it among the new intrinsic-function names)

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMSMALLALG.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 X-INT PIC S999.
01 R3 PIC S9(3).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.

    COMPUTE R3 = FUNCTION SMALLEST-ALGEBRAIC(X-INT)
    DISPLAY R3
    STOP RUN.
